decisive_spans.text: Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement

response.rationale: The presence of CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+ atypical lymphocytes, along with a clonal IgH gene rearrangement, strongly supports Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. D4 is a runner-up because it mentions CD20+ expression, but lacks the additional markers and IgH gene rearrangement that D3 has.
